question.text: $n$ identical waves each of intensity $I_0$ interfere with each other. The ratio of maximum intensities if the interference is (i) coherent and (ii) incoherent is :

solution.text: $\frac{\text { (Maximum intensity) coherent interference }}{\text { (Maximum intensity) coherent interference }}$ $=\frac{\mathrm{n}^2 \mathrm{I}_0}{\mathrm{nI}_0}=\mathrm{n}$
